title: Broadcom Credit Risk Soars on Mega AI Debt Financing Backstops - Yahoo Finance
snippet: 3. Best balance transfer cards. (Bloomberg) -- Bond traders have ramped up measures of credit risk associated with Broadcom Inc. as it backstops mega financing packages for the buildout of artificial intelligence. Broadcom is in talks to raise more than $60 billion in debt for an AI chip financing deal that is expected to benefit Anthropic PBC and other companies. That's after it struck an agreement earlier this year to backstop most of a $35 billion debt package while investors including Apollo Global Management Inc. and Blackstone Inc. financed the purchase of custom AI chips to lease to Anthropic. "This adds to recent concerns around the growing layer of 'phantom leverage' growing underneath the vast AI ecosystem as the backlog of leases, purchase commitments, residual value guarantees and other backstops is poised to stretch into the trillions," Tarek Hamid, a strategist at JPMorgan Chase & Co., wrote in a note on Monday, in reference to Broadcom's potential $60 billion financing deal.
